g.text: HexaBlock Suite: the four variants as instantiations of the engine (layer 1, src/domain/variants/)
Light yellow: engine types from part 1 (src/domain/engine/), shown without members.
Dark yellow: variant types (src/domain/variants/<variant>/). Both are layer 1, entities.
«bind» arrow: UML template binding. Its label names the type each parameter takes.
Rule variants-isolated: a variant imports the engine and never another variant.
clears full lines on the 3 axes
cells placed plus a bonus per line
cascade transfer, clears a stack of 10
pieces: seeded or fixed, per level (A4)
slide to the edge, merge on collision
The rules call canMergeWith and mergeWith,
so they need that capability of the cell.
A plain number cannot implement an interface,
build() checks A5: the areas match, and the
witness placement covers the figure exactly.
An adapter parses the JSON or YAML file;
A3: reaching the target tile is an event,
not the end of the game.
